A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the VCSEL can be injection-locked by a downstream signal at a bit rate up to 10 Gb/s, with an injection-locking range up to 1.6 nm.
we have demonstrated the first optically injection- locked VCSEL operating in the 1.55 μm wavelength region and have also demonstrated the first VCSEL-based WDM PON.
we have demonstrated the first ever isolator-less, 10 Gbit/s, directly modulated, injection-locked, 1.55 μm VCSEL.
The main takeaway from our work is that
an optically injection- locked 1.55 um VCSEL is a good candidate for an isolator-free directly modulated transmitter for WDM-PON applications.
the injection locking of VCSELs can be used to achieve a low-cost isolator-free upstream transmitter for WDM-PON applications.
